name: comp-224
title: Plan Description Select
description: A labelled dropdown of plans whose open rows pair each plan name with a short grey description, while the closed trigger keeps only the name. The chosen plan ends in a tick.
use: When each choice needs a one-line explanation, such as plans or tiers, and the closed field must stay short.
avoid: The open list sits over the field label and hides most of it, so the label must be short or repeated elsewhere.
a11y: The label is tied to the trigger and each option keeps its description in the text, so both are read aloud; the open animation ignores reduced-motion settings. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A long white field label sits above a compact rounded trigger reading Pro Plan with a chevron. Opened, a dark panel shows three rows, each a plan name followed by a small grey blurb, the selected one ticked at its right edge.
behaves: Clicking the trigger drops the list over the label; hovering a row highlights it, and choosing one closes the panel, leaving just the plan name in the trigger. The clip settles on Enterprise Plan.
customise: The three plans and their blurbs are written in the file; edit the text or add rows there. The trigger drops descriptions through a class, and the menu spacing is set in the same file.
weight: light: Three text rows in a popup with one short open animation.
